title: tsn 1.1.0
text: New vignette("pleasure--functions"): complete tutorial using packaged motivation$pleasure measurements demonstrate nine exported functions, standard result interface, cograph-network plots. New Nestimate bridge: ts_tna(), ts_ftna(), ts_cna(), ts_atna() discretize one many time series build matching Nestimate transition-network model (netobject) keeps source data ($ts_source) — plottable compatible Nestimate analyses whose sampling requirements data satisfy. Node order follows state level order (low/mid/high), alphabetical. New series_networks() verb: splits pooled bridge model one full model per source series, sharing node set order direct comparison retaining original Nestimate builder settings. plot() bridge result draws series beside transition network row — default series’ network (network = "per_series"); network = "summary" draws pooled model spanning rows instead. Networks render exclusively cograph::splot(), state-matched node fills nodes sized -strength (self-loops excluded); ... passes straight splot. New time-series plot types, base graphics. plot() discretize() result accepts type = "ribbon" (clean series state-classification strip underneath), "heatmap" (one row per series, one tile per observation — compares state timing across many series), "stack" (companion series original values stacked discretized series, panels shaded discretized states, optional state-coloured line segments via color_line), alongside previous shaded view (now type = "overlay", still default). overlay view combines colour shading one direction dashed guide lines via lines = ("horizontal" state boundaries, "vertical" persistent state transitions filtered min_run). plot() trend() result accepts "ribbon", "heatmap", "panels" (series stacked rolling metric classified ), alongside previous default (type = "points"). Five new distance measures tsn(method = "distance"), base-R new dependencies: "ccf" (one minus maximum absolute cross-correlation across lags), "nmi" (one minus normalized mutual information shared quantile bins), "voi" (variation information), "event_sync" (one minus Quiroga event-synchronization index event times), "van_rossum" (exact closed-form van Rossum spike-train distance). New method-specific arguments: bins (nmi/voi), lag (ccf), tolerance (optional cap adaptive event-synchronization windows, van Rossum time constant). NMI VoI verified equivalent aricode; van Rossum exact form verified discretized-grid reference. Visibility geometry, edge distances, temporal limits, decay now use supplied numeric date-time axis; nonnumeric labels use observation steps. Collision-safe node labels preserve distinct (id, time) pairs. Temporal discretizers now compute ordinal patterns, adaptive-magnitude features, DTW windows within series fitting shared state vocabulary, preventing patterns crossing ID boundaries. Ordinal transition builders exclude trailing display-fill labels, NMI/VoI now use marginal quantile bins monotone rescaling preserves expected information distance. Distance chains preserve caller series order never link last window one series first window another. Event synchronization now implements adaptive Quian Quiroga–Kreuz– Grassberger coincidence window validates strictly increasing event times. trend() now supports missing observations, respects numeric/date elapsed time, handles character time without coercion warnings, avoids infinite growth factors, validates classification thresholds. Plot guides now map transformed magnitude-space breaks back raw signed axis; cograph transition-network node sizing excludes self-loops, show_weights = FALSE honoured. New similarity argument selecting distance--weight kernel: "inverse" (previous fixed rule), "normalized_inverse", "negative_exp", "gaussian", latter two scaled bandwidth (defaulting median positive distance). normalize now also accepts mode names: TRUE/"max" (previous behaviour), "minmax", "quantile" (5th-95th percentile winsorized scaling). Full upstream coverage: ported trend() (rolling OLS, Theil-Sen, Spearman, Kendall, growth-factor trend classification epsilon flat band, turbulence override, center/right/left alignment) public discretize() verb custom labels log/zscore transforms. Added vg() verb visibility graphs: vg(x) vg(x, "horizontal") discoverable, named-argument wrappers around tsn(method = "visibility"). Results now dual-class c("tsn", "netobject", "cograph_network") objects. cograph installed, cograph::splot(x) renders tsn network directly; .data.frame(x) still returns tidy dyad table .data.frame(x, = "series") source series. Network plots now delegate exclusively cograph::splot(); tsn longer maintains second generic graph renderer. plot(x, "series") retains package-specific source-series view. Method-string shortcuts: tsn(x, "hvg"), tsn(x, "nvg"), tsn(x, "distance"), every discretizer name (tsn(x, "ordinal"), tsn(x, "quantile"), …) direct method bare numeric vector. Fifteen discretizers reachable tsn(unit = "state") discretize(), identical state assignments. New network options: chain (consecutive-transition chains), directed distance networks, normalize.

title: tsn 1.0.0
text: Rebuilt package around single tsn() entry point. Added whole-series sliding-window distance networks. Added base-R natural, horizontal, penetrable visibility graphs. Added ten base-R distance measures, including unequal-length DTW. Added five consistent distance--network connection rules. Added seven internal state discretizers, including base-R Gaussian mixture. Standardized every result behind tsn class tidy dyad-table access. Removed external runtime dependencies overlapping network verbs. Corrected legacy selection, similarity direction, state ordering, DTW, visibility duplication, interleaved-ID defects.
